title: SWTOR5SyndicateStrategySystem
description: Data contracts for the CoruscantConquestOverlay grand strategy component in star-wars-rpg.jsx. All sector coordinates are SVG canvas units inside a 760x520 viewBox.

GarrisonComposition.description: Unit counts garrisoned inside a ConquestSector. Keys match CONQUEST_UNIT_TYPES keys.

inf.description: Enforcer Infantry units. Combat power 10 each.

tnk.description: Assault Tanks. Combat power 75 each. Upkeep 2 PWR/turn.

ConquestSector.description: A single territory on the Coruscant sector map. Lives as a value inside the CONQUEST_SECTORS_INIT constant and inside the sectors React state object (keyed by id).

id.description: Unique sector key matching its key in the sectors object.

name.description: Display name shown in SVG labels and the sector inspector.

owner.description: Which faction controls this sector. player = Your Syndicate.

cx.description: SVG center-X for the sector node circle.

cy.description: SVG center-Y for the sector node circle.

adj.description: Array of adjacent sector IDs. Used for attack eligibility and AI targeting.

income.description: Base credits collected per End Turn when owner = player.

pwr.description: Base power cells generated per End Turn when owner = player.

def.description: Defense rating 0-100. Multiplied against garrison CP on attack resolution.

bld.description: IDs of CONQUEST_BUILDINGS entries already constructed here.

ConquestFactionData.description: Entry in CONQUEST_FACTION_DATA. Defines AI behaviour and presentation per faction.

color.description: Hex accent used for sector nodes, bars, and labels.

aggr.description: Aggression score 0-100. Each End Turn, (random * 100 < aggr/2) determines if faction attempts an attack.

aiProfile.description: Key into AI_COMBAT_PROFILES used when faction battle launches TacticalGridCombatOverlay.

startRel.description: Initial relation value seeded into the relations state object. Player faction omits this.

ConquestUnitType.description: Entry in CONQUEST_UNIT_TYPES. Defines recruitment cost and overworld combat power contribution.

costCR.description: Credits spent per unit on Recruit.

costPWR.description: Power cells spent per unit on Recruit.

upPWR.description: Power cells consumed per unit per End Turn as upkeep.

cp.description: Combat power contribution per unit. Used in auto-resolve formula and attack-button display.

ConquestBuilding.description: Entry in CONQUEST_BUILDINGS array. Constructed in player-owned sectors from the Build tab.

defBonus.description: Permanent defense rating increase applied to the sector on construction.

incBonus.description: Flat CR added to the sector's income each End Turn.

pwrBonus.description: Power cells added to per-sector generation each End Turn.

CrisisCard.description: Entry in CONQUEST_CRISIS_CARDS. Drawn every 2 turns if heatMin threshold is met.

desc.description: Shown in the crisis banner during the affected turn.

heatMin.description: Minimum current heat for this card to enter the eligible pool.

type.description: Effect type processed in endTurn(). income_penalty: cuts income 60%. power_loss: -8 PWR. recruit_discount: sets discountActive=true. credit_bonus: +400 CR. def_penalty: a random player sector loses 20 def for 2 turns + heat +15.

ConquestResources.description: The res state slice in CoruscantConquestOverlay.

cr.description: Credit treasury. Gained from sector income, smuggling, and crisis bonuses. Spent on units, buildings, diplomacy, and agent deployments.

pwr.description: Power cell reserve. Gained from sector power generation and Sub-Station buildings. Spent on unit recruitment and building construction.

BattleState.description: The battle state slice when a tactical engagement is in progress. When non-null, CoruscantConquestOverlay renders TacticalGridCombatOverlay in place of its own UI.

sectorId.description: ID of the sector being contested.

fk.description: Defending faction key. Maps to CONQUEST_FACTION_DATA[fk].aiProfile.

DefPenalty.description: Tracks a temporary defense reduction applied by the def_penalty crisis card.

AgentRecord.description: Covert agent shown in the Missions tab.

SmuggleRoute.description: Passive income route processed each End Turn. Rolls against intercept risk.

profit.description: CR added on a successful (non-intercepted) turn.

risk.description: Percent chance each turn the cargo is seized (profit not collected; log entry added).

ConquestMinigamePayload.description: Object shape for setActiveMinigame({ type: 'coruscant_conquest', ... }) dispatch.

onSuccess.description: Callback invoked when all 5 sectors are player-controlled.

onFailure.description: Callback invoked when the player exits the overlay.

startCredits.description: Optional: seed the starting CR treasury. Defaults to 3000 if omitted.

description: Top-level wrapper — each sub-schema maps to a constant or state slice inside CoruscantConquestOverlay.

CONQUEST_SECTORS_INIT.description: Keyed by sector id. Values follow ConquestSector schema. Level 1313 starts player-owned; other sectors are enemy-held.

CONQUEST_UNIT_TYPES.description: Keys: inf, snp, tnk. Values follow ConquestUnitType schema.

activeConquestState.description: Runtime state of CoruscantConquestOverlay. Not persisted across sessions.
